prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Ostra, age70 kind elderly small hunched survivor. White-grey bun #d8d4cc above soft low plum hood #6e4a6e pushed back. Thin round brass wire spectacles #b08d4a, light olive skin #d9a07a, two wrinkle lines each eye, tiny upturned arc eyes. Grey wool coat #8c8a80 with rounded triangular quilt shawl six large flat patches muted plum ochre teal cream rust moss, simple stitched borders. Plum scarf #7d4a8c. Baggy brown trousers #6a4a3a tucked grey felt boots, NO skirt. Short coat hem y254, visible separate legs. Slight 5degree forward hunch.
Torso correction sheet, the same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Exactly THREE isolated SLEEVELESS torso parts in one horizontal row: LEFT strict FRONT view, CENTRE strict SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT (chest faces right, back left, only one flank visible), RIGHT strict BACK view (no buttons/front pockets). Each coat body from collar to hip-length hem. No head, arms, sleeve tubes, sleeve stubs, mittens or legs. Smooth continuous simple side silhouette shoulder to hem, no elbow bulges. Full solid collar top and body under shoulder joints. Six-patch quilt shawl MUST hang from shoulders all the way to coat hem, forming a broad ROUND TRIANGLE covering almost all torso. Six large plum ochre teal cream rust moss patches, stitched borders. Grey coat only glimpsed lower edge. Mild 5degree forward hunch in profile. Transparent background. Generous blank gaps between torso parts, equal cells. Plain flat fills. No labels.
